licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the full distribution: fraud/misrepresentation captures license and practice deception; criminal conviction captures penal offenses; negligence and incompetence captures substandard care; substance abuse and impairment captures addiction/fitness issues; unprofessional conduct captures ethical/behavioral violations not fitting narrower buckets; drug prescribing violations captures the large cluster of controlled-substance prescribing abuses; regulatory and reporting failures captures non-compliance with rules, orders, and reporting duties; sexual misconduct captures patient exploitation; and disciplinary action elsewhere captures reciprocal discipline.
